title: How to Remove Sync Follower
body:
After Changing Smartphone from my Follower, i just added the New Follower.

How can i Remove the old Follower, which isnt present anymore?

xDrip shows every time the message:

No follower sync for: xxx time

Because thw old Follower phone is turned off.

Thank you so much for an answer

comments.body:
Thanks for your fast answer and the nice guide, but im using xDrip Sync as Master an Follower. 
I can klick Manage Followers in Dexcom Share. 
Thats not the solution

The follower will likely expire automatically after a while. If you want to cut off an active follower (which I don't think is what you're talking about here) then you would change the group sync security key.

Hey, thanks for the answer.

It Works! So easy. Thank you

After 2nd change of Securitykey

I rewrite my last comment.

The Issue is the same as before. :-(
I believe the "No follower sync" message would only appear on a follower. Where are you seeing it?
The Message appears to the Master
@LaNiSa2016 Are you still having this problem?
